alert.rule_name: LSASS Process Memory Read via Suspicious Handle
alert.description: A process obtained a handle to lsass.exe with access rights permitting memory reads (PROCESS_VM_READ). LSASS holds plaintext credentials, hashes, and Kerberos tickets in memory; non-security-tooling reads of LSASS are a high-fidelity indicator of credential theft, independent of the dumping tool used.
alert.detection_logic: Sysmon EventID=10 (ProcessAccess) WHERE TargetImage ENDSWITH '\lsass.exe' AND GrantedAccess IN (0x1010,0x1038,0x1410,0x1438,0x143a,0x1fffff) AND SourceImage NOT IN (known_security_tooling) AND SourceImage NOT IN (wininit.exe, csrss.exe, services.exe, MsMpEng.exe)
